Air Conditioner.summary: High-efficiency central air conditioning, sized to your home and installed by licensed HVAC technicians.
scope: Remove and dispose of the existing condenser and indoor coil
Set the new outdoor unit on a level pad with code clearances
Install a matched evaporator coil; braze and pressure-test the line set
Evacuate, weigh in refrigerant, and verify superheat/subcooling
Commission the system and confirm cooling performance

Furnace.summary: High-efficiency gas furnace supply and installation, vented and commissioned to manufacturer and code requirements.
scope: Disconnect and remove the existing furnace
Set the new furnace and connect supply/return plenums
Run and terminate intake/exhaust venting to code
Connect gas, electrical, and condensate; verify gas pressure
Start up, set temperature rise, and confirm safe combustion

Humidifier.summary: Whole-home bypass humidifier integrated with your furnace for balanced winter comfort.
scope: Mount the humidifier to the supply or return plenum
Connect water supply, drain, and humidistat
Wire to the furnace and set the target humidity
Test the fill/drain cycle and confirm operation

Smart Thermostat.summary: Smart Wi-Fi thermostat with scheduling and remote control, professionally installed and configured.
scope: Remove the old thermostat and verify wiring/C-wire
Mount and connect the new smart thermostat
Configure equipment type, Wi-Fi, and app pairing
Test heating/cooling calls and confirm operation

Water Heater.summary: Tank water heater supply and installation with code-compliant venting and connections.
scope: Drain and remove the old water heater
Set the new tank and connect water, gas, and venting
Install a new T&P relief valve and expansion tank as required
Fill, purge air, and check for leaks
Light/commission and confirm hot-water delivery

Tankless Water Heater.summary: On-demand tankless water heater for endless hot water and lower standby losses, installed to spec.
scope: Remove the existing unit and prepare gas, water, and venting
Mount the tankless unit and run concentric/stainless venting to code
Upsize gas line and add isolation/service valves as required
Connect, purge, and configure temperature settings
Commission and verify flow rate and combustion

Water Softener.summary: Whole-home water softener to reduce hardness, scale, and spotting, installed and commissioned.
scope: Install the softener and bypass valve on the main line
Connect inlet/outlet plumbing and the drain line
Load media/brine and program the regeneration cycle
Pressure-test, sanitize, and confirm soft-water output

Reverse Osmosis.summary: Under-sink reverse-osmosis drinking water system for clean, great-tasting water.
scope: Install the RO manifold, membrane, and storage tank
Tee into the cold supply and add a dedicated faucet
Connect the drain saddle and flush the membrane
Pressure-test and check for leaks
Sanitize and confirm water quality/flow

Heat Pump.summary: Energy-efficient ducted heat pump for year-round heating and cooling, professionally sized and installed.
scope: Remove existing equipment and prepare the install location
Set the outdoor heat pump and matched indoor coil/air handler
Braze, pressure-test, and evacuate the refrigerant circuit
Configure defrost/auxiliary heat and verify both modes
Commission and confirm heating and cooling performance

Battery Backup.summary: Home battery backup that stores low-cost off-peak power for outages and to cut expensive peak-hour usage.
scope: Mount the battery and inverter and tie into the electrical panel
Wire backup/transfer circuits for the protected loads
Configure charging for off-peak / time-of-use savings
Commission, test backup transfer, and verify monitoring

Air Purifier.summary: Whole-home air purification installed in the ductwork to capture airborne particles and improve indoor air quality.
scope: Install the air-cleaning unit at the furnace/air handler return
Wire the unit to run with the system blower
Seal duct connections and verify airflow
Test operation and review maintenance with the homeowner
